Long Kiln.name: Long Kiln
Long Kiln.description: The user braces on both feet and tail and exhales a single column of flame down the length of a freight platform. The breath lasts one turn and deals massive fire damage to barriers and foes in its path. To hold back, the user narrows the column and burns a strip of bare paving ahead of a charge, leaving room on either side to retreat. The user's chest plates stay spread after the exhale, exposing their seams for the two full turns the user must hold a fresh breath before firing again. Strain: severe.
